items.item_text: Medical Assistant Certification: CA (MAC:CA) or National Registered/Certified Medical Assistant NAHP (NRCMA)

Answer telephones in a timely and professional manner. Take accurate phone messages and relay them to appropriate staff and physician in a timely manner. Maintain communication among the staff, physician, patient, insurance company and hospital. Ensures timely response to pharmacy matters, including Rx faxes. Communicate with appropriate personal when issuing related to authorization medical information may have measurable effect on care provider.

Prepares exam rooms with necessary supplies while maintaining a clean, organized, and safe environment, and performing patient care services that support the physician / provider's practice under the clinical supervision of the Physician or Nurse Practitioner. Rooms patients in a timely fashion to expedite patient flow. Assisting in preparing patients for examinations or procedures, assisting with procedures, relaying instructions from the physician to a patient or authorized person, and collecting patient data. Administering medications specifically directed by the physician and performing accurate vital sign measurements and documentation. Follows all hospitals policies regarding patient care and safety. Scheduling tests and off-site procedures as necessary. Maintain an organized environment to facilitate patient care as follow-up. Work with physicians, insurance providers, and pharmacies to obtain authorizations for patient medication, including refills. Completes vital signs, documents results in medical record and ensures all intake forms and medications are documented in the medical record.

Priorities and organized time effectively to ensure efficient operations. Demonstrates the ability to be flexible and offers to assist co-workers to provide effective flow. Update and inform Supervisor regarding crucial issues, including concerns regarding any aspects of welfare or physician.

Ensures the chart are prepared for the physician to effectively conduct the clinic appointment. IE; Imaging or specialty results etc. Ensures timely completion of patient related correspondence, e.g. disability forms. Maintain log of pt correspondence forms to ensure follow-up an requests. Completes all referrals and authorizations for services as requested by MD.
Must have completed a medical assistant training program
Two (2) years of e xperience in an outpatient setting as clinical medical assistant
